entities.name: Báetán mac Cairill
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Báetán mac Cairill was king of the Dál Fiatach, and high-king of Ulaid, from c. 572 until his death. He was the son of Cairell mac Muiredaig Muinderg and brother of Demmán mac Cairill, previous Kings of Ulaid. According to some sources, he was high-king of Ireland.
